results.title: 8 best ChatGPT pages alternatives in 2026: free and paid picks | eesel AI
results.content:
Is there a free alternative to ChatGPT pages?

Yes. Gemini Canvas is free in the Gemini app, ChatGPT Projects and writing blocks work on the Free plan, and Copilot Pages comes at no extra cost with the free Copilot Chat on eligible Microsoft 365 work accounts. None of the free options give you a live, multi-person AI doc quite like a ChatGPT page, so treat them as drafting tools first. My ChatGPT alternatives list covers more free picks.

Can ChatGPT Plus users get ChatGPT pages?

Not at launch. ChatGPT pages come with ChatGPT Space on Pro, Business, and Enterprise only. Plus users can keep using Projects and writing blocks, or move to a ChatGPT pages alternative like Claude Docs or Notion. The full plan breakdown is in my ChatGPT pricing guide. [...] 1. Plan gating. Pages come with ChatGPT Space, which is listed for Pro, Business, and Enterprise only. Plus and Free users don't get it, so the cheapest way in ends up being a Business Standard seat at $20 a month billed yearly, with a two-seat minimum.
2. Unfinished pieces. OpenAI's getting started guide says "Automatic page updates with Keep updated are not available at launch," and mobile is read and share only.
3. Lock-in. A page lives inside ChatGPT, and the only models that can edit it are OpenAI's.
4. Launch-week bugs. On October 1 the OpenAI help center was still showing a banner for "Elevated errors in ChatGPT Space Pages."

The reaction on X was pretty blunt. This one is a low-engagement post, but it sums up quite well what a lot of the early testers were feeling: [...] Sometimes the best ChatGPT pages alternative is just ChatGPT itself. OpenAI's Projects help article says projects keep related chats, files, and instructions together, and they run on every plan, Free included. Inside a chat, writing blocks are what replaced canvas on May 28, 2026, and they got a full-screen editor on June 8.

That combination covers most of the solo work. You keep a project with your files and instructions in it, and the long drafts open up in a writing block. OpenAI also says creating a space "does not replace your existing Projects," so nothing in here goes away if you decide to upgrade later.

results.title: 5 ChatGPT Alternatives to Know in 2026 (+ More to Consider) | Coursera
results.content:
ChatGPT is one of the most popular generative AI (genAI) tools out there today, often synonymously used to describe the technology itself. That said, it's far from the only genAI tool that you should consider using. At a glance, here's what you need to know about ChatGPT and its alternatives:

 ChatGPT hit over 800 million weekly active users as of October 2025 .
 Common uses of ChatGPT and similar, alternative tools include to generate text, analyze data, and write programming code, as well as others.
 Alternatives to ChatGPT include Anthrophic's Claude, Google Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, xAI's Grok, and Meta AI. [...] AnonChatGPT: This ChatGPT alternative, with no login requirements, provides a simple and free option for obtaining reliable service. It is a good option if you have privacy concerns related to AI use.

 character.ai: This chatbot service lets you create AI companions that you can have natural conversations with. The characters may be simulations of real-life celebrities or fictional characters. You can also create your own AI assistant, which is personalized just for you. The purpose of character.ai is to provide you with informative output rather than entertainment. You can use it to help with brainstorming ideas or engaging in creative conversations. [...] Considerations: You may find that content generated by Perplexity is not as creative or conversational as that of other tools. It also may not be the best option if you are looking for a tool to create content. Finally, as with other conversational AI tools, hallucinations do appear, making it important that you check the accuracy of the AI-created content.

### Other ChatGPT alternatives to consider

ChatGPT and the above alternatives represent only some of the available generative AI tools out there today. Other alternatives to ChatGPT worth considering include:

• Grok: The AI assistant designed by xAI and integrated into X (formerly Twitter).

• DeepSeek: A popular, low-cost generative AI tool offered by a Chinese company of the same name.
